title: Prepare Hyperswitch card-vault annotation packet
description: Evaluate juspay/hyperswitch-card-vault at pinned commit abfca8e078039582460335be73341699ee826615 as a Rust PCI and cardholder-data candidate. Verify repository identity and license, define a manageable complete scope around src/routes/data/types.rs or a justified enclosing directory, inventory all included source and exclusions, and prepare scanner-independent proposed annotations for applicable layers. Include positive, negative, ambiguous, evidence, rationale, and provenance records. Unsupported Rust scanning must later report unread rather than a clean negative. Keep all annotations proposed pending human review.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Outside-consultant corpus session has started this packet after independently verifying the exact pin and Apache-2.0 license. Work is source-only and scanner-blind: materialize the declared complete Rust file, inventory every relevant declaration, prepare proposed annotations, then present human-review decisions. No agent may mark a record accepted.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Prepared the first scanner-blind, source-only proposed packet: Hyperswitch Card Vault at abfca8e078039582460335be73341699ee826615 (Apache-2.0), with one complete 206-line Rust file as its scope and 29 proposed data-item records. Human review worksheet groups firm card-data positives, firm negatives, and taxonomy-dependent ambiguous values. Manifest/unit validation passes; no annotation is accepted or counted yet.
